concept: The story is a streak that looked unbreakable, broken by a team that then nearly threw it away, so the hero is a setup and a sting: 'Spain hadn't lost in 43 games' in muted grey, 'England were 3-0 up by the 57th minute' in white. Slide 2 makes the 43 huge on its own so the size of the run lands before the details. Slide 3 is the 12-minute burst as a clean minute-by-minute list, slide 4 flips the mood with a big 2 (the Spain comeback after the red card) and slide 5 says what both teams play for next and asks fans to judge the win. Football green, type only: no player photos, no crests or federation logos.
caption:
43 games unbeaten. Ended in Madrid by an England side that nearly let a 3-0 lead slip.

Harry Kane scored a penalty right before half-time. Ezri Konsa headed in a Declan Rice corner and Ben White made it 3-0 inside an hour. Spain, world and European champions, had no shot on target in the first half.

Then Elliot Anderson was sent off for a foul on Lamine Yamal in the box. Oyarzabal scored the penalty, Nico Williams pulled another back and James Trafford needed a stoppage-time double save to keep it 3-2.

Spain's last defeat before Sunday was a March 2024 friendly against Colombia. England now top Group A3 on goal difference and both teams go into the March quarter-finals.
